tools.name: card_lookup
tools.description: A Magic card's identity (mana cost, type, color identity, legalities, image) and what ArcaneMetriX reads in it: its role in a deck and its tags. Takes a card name or a Scryfall oracle id; a name that matches nothing exactly returns close matches to choose from.

tools.name: card_synergy
tools.description: The cards that work best with a card, ranked, each with what they share. Give `with` to ask instead whether two particular cards work together, how strongly, and why.

tools.name: bracket_check
tools.description: A Commander decklist's bracket (1-5) and the reasons behind it: Game Changers, two-card combos, mass land denial, extra turns and tutors, each with the cards involved.

tools.name: deck_analyze
tools.description: A Commander decklist read whole: its bracket and why, the themes it is built around, and the functional categories (ramp, card draw, removal, …) it is short on.

tools.name: suggest_cards
tools.description: Up to ten cards to add to a Commander decklist, ranked, each with the reason, built toward a bracket when one is given.

tools.name: list_my_decks
tools.description: The signed-in user's ArcaneMetriX decks, newest first: name, format, commanders, card count and bracket. Needs the user to connect their account (decks:read).

tools.name: get_my_deck
tools.description: One of the user's decks card by card, with its commanders, sideboard and notes. Needs decks:read.

tools.name: analyze_my_deck
tools.description: The bracket check of one of the user's saved decks: its bracket and the reasons behind it. Needs decks:read.

tools.name: check_my_collection
tools.description: How many copies of each card the user owns in their ArcaneMetriX collection (needs their PRO membership and collection:read). Takes up to 100 card names or oracle ids.

tools.name: my_pod_schedule
tools.description: The upcoming game nights the user's pods have planned (a user may be in up to three): which pod, when, where, what formats, how many are going and the user's own answer. Pass pod_id for one pod's. Needs pods:read.
